exposure: combination nursing of PDCA and ERAS
outcome: first urination along after leaving bed
cohort: One hundred and thirty patients undergoing caesarean section at the Second Affiliated Hospital of Nantong University were randomly divided into a control group and an intervention group.
finding: A combination nursing of PDCA and ERAS alleviated postoperative pain, improved psychological state, expedited postoperative recovery, and lessened the incidence of complications in patients undergoing cesarean section.
